caption: The drawing depicts two sheep, one large and one small, both lying on a flat, elongated oval base. The larger sheep is positioned behind the smaller one, both facing slightly to the left. The large sheep has textured, curly fur shaded in tones of gray, brown, and white, with yellow and orange details in the eyes and inner ears. The smaller sheep is lighter in color, predominantly gray with subtle hints of brown and white on its body, and has similarly colored ears. The flat base on which they rest features alternating diagonal stripes colored in red, yellow, and black along its visible edge. The background is a plain, unadorned light beige. The name "B. Harris" appears near the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Pa. German Chalkware Sheep
